action.ambiguous.header: Several action plans are awaiting confirmation in this conversation. Say which one, for example "confirm 1":
action.cancel_already_handled: This action plan has already been handled (current status: %s), so it cannot be cancelled.
action.cancelled: Action plan cancelled, nothing was run.
action.pending_expired: The pending proposal has expired: ask for the action again to get a new one.
action.plan_already_handled: This action plan has already been handled (current status: %s).
action.plan_expired: This action plan has expired: ask again and I will propose it anew.
action.plan_forbidden: You are not allowed to confirm this action plan.
action.plan_just_handled: This action plan has just been handled.
action.plan_not_found: There is no plan number %d awaiting confirmation in this conversation.
action.proposal.footer: Reply "confirm" to run them, or "cancel" to drop them. This proposal expires in %s.
action.proposal.superseded: (replaces the previous proposal, which went unanswered)
action.report.all_succeeded: Every action in the plan ran successfully:
action.report.none: No action in the plan could be run:
agent.actions_over_limit: ⚠️ This turn produced %d actions to confirm, beyond the limit of %d set for agent %q. Nothing was recorded: ask again, split into several steps.
audio.empty_transcription: I could not hear anything in this voice message. Record it again a little closer to the microphone, or write to me instead.
audio.too_large: This voice message is too long for me to process. Send a shorter one, or write to me instead.
audio.unsupported_format: I cannot read this audio format. Send me a voice message recorded from WhatsApp, or write to me instead.
ingress.fallback_reply: Sorry, I could not process this message. Try again in a moment.
linking.already_linked: This messaging account is already attached to another profile. Contact whoever manages your access.
linking.group_linked: This conversation is now attached to "%s". Mention me when you need me — I only read what is addressed to me.
linking.token_invalid: This code is no longer valid. Ask whoever manages your access for a new one.
linking.welcome: Hello %s! Your account is linked and I am at your disposal. Write to me as you would to a person: I can remember what matters, remind you of things, work on the files you send me and keep your documents.
mail.verification.ignore: If you did not ask for this, simply ignore this message.
mail.verification.instructions: Enter it on the profile page opened from your conversation with Automata. It expires in ten minutes.
mail.verification.subject: Your Automata code: %s
mission.stalled: I can no longer make progress on "%s": the last %d wake-ups failed. I will keep trying; you can also drop the mission if it no longer serves.
onboarding.done: Thank you, I am noting all of that. You can now ask me for whatever you need: remembering something, reminding you of a deadline, working on a file you send me, or keeping a document safe. Just tell me what you need.
onboarding.offer: Shall we get to know each other in four questions? Reply "yes" — or just ask me what you need, and we will get there along the way.
onboarding.q1: What would you like me to call you?
onboarding.q2: Which time zone do you live in, and when are you usually available? That way I will not offer you a reminder at 3 in the morning.
onboarding.q3: What are you working on, in a few words? I will know what you mean when you mention a project or a case.
onboarding.q4: Last question: do you prefer short answers that get straight to the point, or more detailed ones?
onboarding.stopped: Understood, let us stop there. I am here whenever you need me.
